findings.title: Project-scoped review route omits the six-fact record, decision behavior and integration history, yet offers Accept, Reject and Request delivery
findings.wireframe_ref: wireframes.html line 263 (card 'Six separate facts for the same candidate', class facts) and line 265 (disclosures); operational-design.md S3 (~line 446-456) and S9 (~line 494-503)
findings.evidence: Fixture route '/?fixture=1#/project/fixture-project/review/fixture-task-1?fixture=1&evidence=missing': main text contains no 'Six separate facts', 'Execution finished', 'Decision behavior' or 'Integration, recovery' at 1440, 960 or 760 widths (verified by DOM text; desktop checked in detail). The same content on '#/review' contains all four. Controls present: Accept (disabled), Reject, Request changes, Request delivery (disabled). Screenshot of the fixture state: /tmp/ra-review/shots/project-review-fixture-desktop.png (Task/Approval/Action, Files, Unified diff; no six-fact card). Note: the capture app/project-review.populated.desktop is the disconnected state, not this one.
findings.suspected_root_cause: src/review/ReviewScreen.tsx:115 renders the facts slot only as `{approval && embedded?.facts?.(r)}`, and the behavior/integration disclosures only through embedded slots (src/ui/views/review/ReviewDecisionsView.tsx ~lines 120-150). src/review/ReviewRoute.tsx mounts ReviewScreen without `embedded`, so the standalone detail never gets SixFacts or DecisionBehavior. Mechanism confirmed by DOM absence; fix location is a hypothesis.
findings.check: test('review-and-app-only-01', async ({ page }) => { await openApp(page, '#/project/fixture-project/review/fixture-task-1?fixture=1&evidence=missing', 'populated', 'desktop'); await expect(page.getByText(/^Six separate facts/).first()).toBeVisible(); });
